SRC Decisions Register
This tool records motions passed by the ANUSA Student Representative Council (SRC) only, in their amended form where applicable. It is not currently a record of all ANUSA policy, such as that passed at General Meetings. Unsuccessful motions, amendments and debate are also excluded. The official minutes are the authoritative record, and are linked on each entry. This page is informational only and may contain inaccuracies.
Select a meeting or decision to view details.
